description: This file defines the INativeJS interface within the WPEFramework, specifying methods for initializing, deinitializing, creating, running, and terminating NativeJS applications, as well as executing JavaScript code within the plugin environment.

classes.name: INativeJS
classes.description: An interface for managing NativeJS plugins, including application lifecycle and script execution

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the NativeJS plugin with a Wayland display string

methods.name: CreateApplication
methods.description: Creates a new NativeJS application with specified options and outputs its ID

methods.name: RunApplication
methods.description: Runs a NativeJS application identified by its ID with a specified URL

methods.name: RunJavaScript
methods.description: Executes JavaScript code in a specified NativeJS application using its ID

methods.name: GetApplications
methods.description: Retrieves details of existing NativeJS applications

methods.name: TerminateApplication
methods.description: Destroys a running NativeJS application by its ID
